resources.string: Device admin active, but NOT Device Owner
This app is the Device Owner. Payment policies can be enforced in later stages. You can always review what the app controls on this screen.
This app cannot enforce any device policy until it is set as Device Owner on a freshly reset test device.

1. Factory-reset the test device (or use a fresh emulator image).
2. Skip Google account sign-in; make sure no accounts exist.
3. Enable USB debugging and install this app.
4. Run on your computer:

adb shell dpm set-device-owner %1$s
This removes this app as Device Owner. Use only on test devices.
Disabling this app may affect your installment agreement. See Support for details.
